title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Administrative Schedule — Filing, Recovery and Termination Timing
content:
These administrative terms are the same on every Orthodontic Benefit Rider (Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000, Child 1500 and Child 2000, and Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500, Family 2000 and Family 3000).

| Term | Value on all six riders | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Claim filing limit | 365 calendar days | the case must be submitted within this many calendar days after the banding date to be established |
| Recovery when treatment is discontinued | no recovery | when treatment is discontinued early, payments already made for service periods that began while covered are not recovered |
| Recovery look-back | 365 calendar days | a payment made for a service period beginning after the rider termination date is reversed and recovered within this many calendar days after its payment date |
| Timing of a voluntary termination | end of the month of confirmation | a confirmed voluntary rider termination takes effect at the end of the month in which it is confirmed |

### Reading the day counts

Both day counts are in calendar days.

*Hypothetical example:* the filing limit is counted in calendar days after the banding date, and the look-back in calendar days after the payment date. A voluntary termination confirmed on 9 August takes effect at the end of August.
